pretreatments.description: Granular sludge collected from a full-scale Up-flow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket (UASB) digester of a brewery factory located in Padova, Italy, characterized by a Total Solids (TS) concentration of 15% and Volatile Solids (VS) concentration of 47% TS.
Heat shock treatment: Granular sludge was boiled at 90°C for 30 minutes.
Aeration treatment: Granular sludge was aerated for 24 hours using an aquarium pump with an air flow rate of 3 L/min.
Alkaline pre-treatment: Granular sludge pH was adjusted to 12.0 ± 0.1 using 3 N NaOH and maintained for 24 hours.
Pre-treatment with WFO: Fifteen g/L of WFO was added to the granular sludge cultures (33 gVS sludge/L saponified WFO solution) and maintained for 24 hours.
Washing treatment: The pretreated cultures were washed three times with tap water by adding tap water and removing the supernatant to remove saponified WFO solution from the granular sludge.
Sample preparation: Substrate samples were mixed and shredded in a kitchen mill to make a homogenous blend.
pH adjustment: pH was adjusted to 5.5 using NaOH (3 M) and HCl (3 M) for the first stage of anaerobic digestion.
pH adjustment: pH was adjusted to 7.0 for the second stage of anaerobic digestion.
Temperature adjustment: Incubation was performed at 35°C.
